items.name: FIXED_SIZE_LIST_WILDCARD
items.summary: Constant that is used as a placeholder for any valid fixed size list. This is used where a function can accept a fixed size list type with any valid length. It exists to avoid the need to enumerate all possible fixed size list lengths.

items.name: TIMEZONE_WILDCARD
items.summary: Constant that is used as a placeholder for any valid timezone. This is used where a function can accept a timestamp type with any valid timezone, it exists to avoid the need to enumerate all possible timezones. See [`TypeSignature`] for mo…
